text:
The Gate 1 revision has been applied to `.sdlc/runs/20261105-105313-feature-new-text-range-styles/requirements.md`:

- **Per-line bidi selector (`FR-5`, `FR-8`, `FR-15`, `FR-17`, `IS-1`, `IS-3`, `IS-7`)**: Updated so that per-visual-line run positioning takes the simple left-prefix measurement path **only** when `!hasRTLChars(line.text)` (`packages/common/src/utils.ts:397–402`), and takes the architect's bidi-aware path whenever `hasRTLChars(line.text)` is `true` (matching `packages/excalidraw/wysiwyg/textWysiwyg.tsx:669–677`), regardless of `isRTL(element.text)`. `isRTL(element.text)` (`packages/common/src/utils.ts:384–395`) is used strictly for the base direction (`dir` on `context.canvas` and `direction` / `text-anchor` on SVG `<text>`).
- **Acceptance criteria (`AC-1`, `AC-4`)**: Updated to specify the per-line `hasRTLChars(line.text)` selector and added LTR-first mixed-direction test cases (e.g. `"Price: ١٢٠ درهم"`, where `isRTL` is `false` but `hasRTLChars` is `true`) for both run-positioning unit tests (`AC-1`) and SVG export `<tspan>` fills and highlight `<rect>` positions (`AC-4`).
- All existing IDs (`FR-1`–`FR-17`, `AC-1`–`AC-6`, `IS-1`–`IS-8`, `OOS-1`–`OOS-8`), sections, Gate 0 decisions, and `Open questions for HITL` (`None`) remain unchanged.
